title: When the Winter Burns
author: Tamsin Coldharbour
blurb: Mara Yarrow, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
